name: Sweden
summary: Nordic nation spanning central and northern boreal biomes. High carbon tax pioneered early fossil fuel displacement, achieving deep grid decarbonization with combined nuclear and hydro power.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.16x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); among the cleanest ambient air quality standards globally.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; SMHI recorded top-four warmest year in modern observational series.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Subpolar warming trend rate of +0.44 °C per decade over trailing 30-year window (1994-2023).

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.1% share of global emissions; lowest greenhouse gas intensity per unit GDP in the EU.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: One of the lowest per capita rates in the developed world due to fossil-free district heating and power.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~282,000 km² of boreal forest; sustainable forestry anchors major timber and pulp industries.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydropower provided 39.8%, onshore wind 21.2%, and bioenergy 7.6% alongside 29.5% nuclear generation.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 26 people/km²; urban population fraction is 88.2%.
